data.name: Surendra
data.gender_notes: Surendra is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘surendra’, meaning ‘the one who has control over all senses and the lord of the universe’. It symbolizes courage, strength, and victory. The name Surendra carries the meaning “Obtainer of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Surendra usually hope their child will grow to embody obtainer of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Surendra reflects the Hindu mythological belief in a supreme deity who possesses unfathomable power and control over all aspects of creation. This concept is prevalent within Indian culture, where the deity is revered and revered devotionally for his strength, courage, and the ability to grant people their desires and wishes - opening doors to victory and success in their lives.

Through the name, one can seek to overcome their inner weaknesses and fears while trusting in the protective and empowering guidance of a higher power to navigate through life's challenges. data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Surendra signifies supreme rule or sovereignty over all. It is a tribute to the god Shiva, who is the universal ruler and controller of all forces in the universe. The name instills courage, strength, and the determination to rule one's own destiny.

vedic_reference.note: Rooted in Sanskrit and Vedic mythology, Surendra is the name of the lord of the ocean, Lord Indra, who is considered the king of gods in Hinduism.

historical_references.reference: Surendra was a king of the Solar Dynasty, who ruled over the region of Haihayas in central India. He is mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. According to legend, he was a powerful and just ruler, who was respected by his people and was a friend to the Pandava brothers.

Surendra was also the name of a king of Bengal who ruled during the 13th and 14th centuries. He is known for his military prowess and is said to have expanded the borders of his kingdom significantly during his reign.

The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
